meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重组输出以适配多动症读者:先给动作、分步骤、限时反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让写出的说明和通知更容易被多动症同事或客户看懂
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your instructions to be clearer for colleagues or customers with ADHD.

howto.what: Claude 会以你能立即执行的具体行动作为回复开头;多步骤任务写成编号清单;每轮对话会标明当前进度;省去与主题无关的话;时间估计给出具体数字;完成后会清楚列出现在能用的结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“/i-have-adhd”后启用;之后对每条消息都生效,直到你说“stop adhd mode”才停止。

say.note: 开启 ADHD 模式,之后你的所有消息都会按此规则回复。

say.text: 我遇到一个调试问题,先给我一个能立刻做的操作。
say.note: 回复会以具体行动开头,而不是解释背景。

say.text: 请把接下来的步骤编号,并给出时间估计。
say.note: 如果任务多步,Claude 会写编号清单并附耗时。

howto.what_en: Claude opens with a concrete next action you can take right away; numbers multi-step tasks; restates progress each turn; cuts off-topic remarks; gives specific time estimates; and lists usable results once done.
howto.when_en: Activates when you type "/i-have-adhd". It then applies to every message until you say "stop adhd mode".

say_en.note: Enables ADHD mode; replies then follow these rules.

say_en.text: Tell me one concrete action for this debugging problem.
say_en.note: Reply leads with an actionable next step, not context.

say_en.text: Number the upcoming steps and estimate time for each.
say_en.note: You get numbered steps with time estimates.
